name: Nishimura Hiroyuki
source:
A human who moved away from the village 5 years ago. He currently just moved back to the village after receiving a letter from a friend there.

He shares his name with the founder and former administrator of 2chan.

[From [url=http://en.wikifur.com/wiki/Morenatsu]Wikifur[/url]]
